cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

mechanism: A directs practical choices by expanding the original shared hope so each setback becomes another way of fulfilling it.
confusable: Distinguish generic optimism from repeatedly returning to the same hope of belonging or togetherness and enlarging its meaning.
comparison: Cottage repair and savings reinterpret belonging as investment; concert outage and absent torch-seekers reinterpret togetherness as shared provision.
seedUse: Canonical cottage and concert seeds supply the sustained hope; use S01 to choose next steps, avoiding both prefixed authority and prematurely claiming absent people already returned.
